key_path: Sign up at postmarkapp.com (free plan, 100 emails/mo, no card)
A default Server is created; Servers > API Tokens shows the Server API token
Add a Sender Signature (confirm via email link) or verify a domain (DKIM + Return-Path DNS)
Until manual account approval, can only send to addresses on own verified domains (or test@blackhole.postmarkapp.com); request approval (<24h on weekdays)
human_gates: manual_approval (every new account reviewed before sending outside own domains)

agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: partial - Account API token (X-Postmark-Account-Token) can create Servers via API, each returning server API tokens; account token itself is dashboard-only
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: partial - Server token (per server/stream) vs Account token; no fine-grained scopes
agent_native_auth.test_credentials_sandbox: yes - magic token POSTMARK_API_TEST validates sends without delivering; blackhole sink address; sandbox server mode
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes - Free plan 100 emails/mo, no overages

mcp.product_mcp_local: npx -y @activecampaign/postmark-mcp (env POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN, DEFAULT_SENDER_EMAIL, DEFAULT_MESSAGE_STREAM); 24 tools with read-only/destructive annotations; MIT
mcp.one_click: Cursor deeplink badge in GitHub README; landing page postmarkapp.com/lp/mcp warns to verify the official package (an impostor unscoped 'postmark-mcp' npm package was a 2025 supply-chain incident)

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://postmarkapp.com/llms.txt (hand-curated, quick-start + task recipes) and https://postmarkapp.com/pricing.txt
docs_for_agents.openapi: yes - ActiveCampaign/postmark-openapi on GitHub (not linked from llms.txt)

time_to_first_call_notes: Token visible right after signup; POSTMARK_API_TEST lets an agent exercise the API in 0 minutes with no account. Real delivery outside own domain waits on manual approval (up to ~24h).
agent_friendliness_justification: Great llms.txt and a no-account test token, plus an annotated official MCP, but MCP is local + raw token only, no OAuth/CLI login, and manual account approval gates real sending.
best_practice: A public magic test token (POSTMARK_API_TEST) documented at the top of llms.txt so agents can validate integrations before any account exists.
biggest_gap: No hosted/OAuth MCP and a human-reviewed account approval before sending to arbitrary recipients.
